denominator: all candidate input fields and source files
review_trigger: any changed fingerprint missing field extra prohibited field or type drift
stop_condition: stop immediately for changed identity or prohibited field

denominator: all rows by declared field and structural state
window: each simulated batch and four-period summary
review_trigger: unexpected missingness change above 10 percentage points or any structural blank coded zero
action: trace transformation and rerun validity review
stop_condition: stop when target feature or structural-state meaning is invalid

denominator: all eligible rows by preregistered feature
window: each simulated batch and four-period summary
review_trigger: standardized difference above 0.20 or value outside accepted range
action: investigate source population and transport assumptions
stop_condition: stop if population no longer matches declared purpose

window: rolling 200 labeled rows or quarterly review
review_trigger: absolute change above 0.05 or fewer than 20 outcomes
action: check label timing completeness and decision meaning
stop_condition: stop performance claims when labels or denominator are inadequate

denominator: labeled rows with both outcome classes
window: rolling 200 labeled rows and quarterly review
review_trigger: ROC AUC below 0.55 or interval cannot be estimated
action: recalculate with uncertainty and compare baseline
stop_condition: stop use if ranking evidence is absent or unstable

window: rolling 200 labeled rows and quarterly review
review_trigger: Brier worse than frozen baseline or material calibration departure
action: rebuild calibration table and inspect prevalence shift
stop_condition: stop probability interpretation if calibration cannot be supported

window: each simulated batch and rolling 200 labels
review_trigger: flag rate changes above 0.20 or sensitivity below 0.50 or PPV below 0.08
action: recount confusion consequences and consult users
stop_condition: stop action use for harmful or unreviewable burden

denominator: labeled rows within every preregistered group
review_trigger: any group below 50 rows or 10 outcomes or a material harm signal
action: suppress unstable metrics and investigate representation
stop_condition: stop differential use or fairness claims

denominator: all jurisdiction-week rows and reporting hospitals
review_trigger: changed fingerprint nonweekly order reporting gap above 30 percent or missing benchmark
action: quarantine refresh and inspect source notice

denominator: all declared tests failures traces and claims
review_trigger: any accepted test fails seeded failure is accepted trace is missing or claim lacks independent evidence
action: block release correct record and rerun suite
stop_condition: stop candidate release until every invariant and owner passes
